# Chase Global Variable At Rate

Source: [6027](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/6027); edited 2025-05-24. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Chase Global Variable At Rate](../../api/actions/chase-global-variable-at-rate.md).

<a id="wiki-6027-n1"></a>

- Chase supports numbers or vectors, but the variable's existing type must match the destination before the chase begins.

<a id="wiki-6027-n2"></a>

- Rate is change per second; selected inputs can be continuously reevaluated. Examples suggest smooth UI counters and animated effect positions.
